title: Senior UI Engineer - Web
description:

You will work closely with UX designers, product managers, and backend engineers to transform ideas into elegant and reliable web experiences. The ideal candidate combines strong front-end engineering fundamentals with creative problem-solving, ownership, and a continuous desire to raise the bar on quality.

Experience developing or contributing to enterprise design systems and component libraries. (this is also covered as part of this point  
  
AEM/Content management experience.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based application development.

**Minimum Qualifications**  
4-8 years of professional front-end engineering experience building large-scale consumer- or enterprise-facing web applications.  
  
Core Web Stack: Deep hands-on expertise in modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, semantic HTML5, and advanced CSS3.  
  
Practical experience using Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent to improve software development workflows  
  
Experience integrating an application with an LLM or AI-powered API is a strong plus.  
  
Frameworks & State Architecture: Proven track record architecting scalable applications using React, Angular, or Vue, coupled with robust state management solutions (e.g., Redux, MobX, Context API, NgRx, or equivalent).

* Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability across enterprise-scale environments
* Proficiency in Java for back-end application development, including experience with modern frameworks and object-oriented design principles

title: Senior Silicon Engineer - Front -End CAD
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to accelerate, the ability to deliver new silicon innovations and infrastructure at scale, with quality, speed, and cost efficiency, has never been more critical. Within SCHIE, the Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) organization plays a pivotal role in enabling Microsoft's silicon strategy. MILE is responsible for end-to-end silicon design methodologies, EDA/CAD ecosystems, and the underlying compute infrastructure that powers the development of Microsoft's custom silicon portfolio - the Azure Cobalt and Azure Maia processors.

We are seeking a Silicon Front-End (FE) CAD Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and support CAD flows and methodologies, as well as dashboards, CAD indicators, and automation used across Microsoft's front-end silicon design ecosystem. The role requires Python software-development skills, hands-on experience building and testing end-to-end, system-level software, and a solid understanding of front-end CAD flows and methodologies.

#SCHIE

 **Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and support Frontend CAD flows and methodologies.

* Design, develop, and maintain CAD software, utilities, and automation for FE flows using Python, following disciplined software-engineering practices.

title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
